construction.camera: One fixed straight source map face, parallel cabinet edges and shallow bevel; no yaw/converging floor slab.
construction.source_supported: Broad source cabinet at rows4..20, rounded diaphragm/grille field, three top marks, paired uprights and crossbars, lower primary vents and two W feet.
construction.authored: Filled housing/recess behind source sparse ink, softly rounded corners, diaphragm shading and fine grille mesh supply material volume. Source black/transparency within cabinet is interpreted as recessed solid speaker assembly, not a mechanical through-hole. Exact hidden depth/mesh weave are authored; no extra cone, control screen, glowing indicator or audio particle. Manual review added narrow primary support necks under top marks and down to pale feet so physical pieces do not float; their source locations/roles unchanged. Top marks interpreted as raised grille/vent caps, not a verified mechanical function. Lower-left recessed marks recovered from original sparse glyph.
construction.coverage: Filled cabinet assembly plus narrowly authored support necks. Gaps around top marks/feet remain transparent; no halo/background accepted.

frame.rule: One full source cell, fixed cabinet/grille/feet geometry and shared palette roles; no generated bounds fitting.
